11. 一長方形金屬薄片的闊度及長度分別量得 8 cm 及 10 cm 準確至最接近的 cm。設 x cm² 為該金屬片的實際面積。求 x 值的範圍。

A. 71.25 ≤ x < 89.25
B. 71.25 < x ≤ 89.25
C. 79.5 ≤ x < 80.5
D. 79.5 < x ≤ 80.5
reasoning:
Since the width and length are measured to the nearest cm, the maximum absolute error for each is 0.5 cm.
The actual width $w$ satisfies $7.5 \le w < 8.5$.
The actual length $l$ satisfies $9.5 \le l < 10.5$.
The actual area $x = w \times l$.
The lower limit of $x$ is $7.5 \times 9.5 = 71.25$.
The upper limit of $x$ is $8.5 \times 10.5 = 89.25$.
Therefore, the range for $x$ is $71.25 \le x < 89.25$.
